note: Frozen. All masters, keys, uids and positions are synthetic. Hex is lower-case; integers are decimal (uid/ctr also as *_hex).

layout.v2: [0]=0x4D [1..4]=uid_le32 [5..8]=ctr_le32 (gen=ctr>>24, seq=ctr&0xFFFFFF) [9..21]=CCM ciphertext of body [22..29]=8-byte tag; AAD=[0..8]; nonce=uid_le32||ctr_le32||0x00||0x00000000; AES-128-CCM L=2 M=8
layout.body: lat_e7 i32le || lon_e7 i32le || fix_epoch u32le || batt_pct u8 (13 B, = v1 [5..17])
layout.kdf: dev_key = AES-CMAC(master, label(12 ASCII) || uid_le32 || gen); labels CID-LORA-BCN (beacon), CID-LORA-CMD (command)
layout.report: [0]=0x52 [1..4]=uid_le32 [5..8]=ctr_le32 (the v2 counter sequence) [9..9+n-1]=CCM ciphertext of the payload (n=1..238) [9+n..9+n+7]=8-byte tag; AAD, nonce and dev_key as v2; frame n+17 = 18..255 B
layout.command: [0]=0x44 [1..4]=uid_le32 [5..8]=cmd_counter_le32 (gen<<24|seq) then CCM ciphertext of echo u32le || valid_from u32le || valid_to u32le || DownlinkPacket (n=1..226) and an 8-byte tag; AAD=[0..8]; nonce=uid_le32||ctr_le32||0x01||0x00000000; key = the COMMAND key (CID-LORA-CMD); frame n+29 = 30..255 B
layout.command_ack: [0]=0x4B [1..4]=uid_le32 [5..8]=the command's counter, then CCM ciphertext of result u8 || command u8 || detail u32le || rssi i8 || snr_q4 i8 and an 8-byte tag; nonce dir 0x02; 25 B
layout.wake: [0]=0x57 [1]=flags (bit 0 MORE, bit 1 LONG, bit 2 ROLL, bits 3..7 = 0) [2..3]=time left u16le in 10 ms units, from the end of this frame to the end of the train's last frame [4]=k, the number of tags (1..4; 0 with ROLL and only then) [5..]=k x u16le tags; tag = fmix32(uid ^ 0x57414B45) & 0xFFFF; 5 + 2k = 5..13 B, cleartext
layout.wake_timing: Ts = 2^SF / BW; toa(n, p) = (p + 4.25 + 8 + max(ceil((8n - 4SF + 44) / (4(SF - 2DE))) x 5, 0)) x Ts with DE = 1 when Ts > 16 ms (coding rate 4/5, explicit header, CRC on); frame = toa(13, 12); tail = toa(13, 8) - 8 Ts; W = tail + 16 Ts + 7 ms; cap = 1.5 x frame + 20 ms; intent_wait = 2 x toa(14, 8) + 150 ms; cmd_window = toa(255, 8) + 300 ms; train >= 1.03 x interval + W + frame; roll_wait = 2 x toa(29, 8) + 150 ms; a roll-call slot >= toa(30, 8) + 5 ms, by default ceil(toa(30, 8)) + 10 ms. *_us are exact microseconds, *_ms the same to 0.1 ms
layout.wake_key: wake_key = AES-CMAC(the owner's command master, 'CID-LORA-WAK' || group_le32 || gen)
layout.roll_call: [0]=0x43 [1..4]=group_le32 [5..8]=ctr_le32 (gen<<24|seq) [9..20]=CCM ciphertext of valid_from u32le || valid_to u32le || slots u8 || slot_ms u16le || flags u8 [21..28]=8-byte tag; AAD=[0..8]; nonce=group_le32||ctr_le32||0x03||0x00000000; key = the group's wake key; 29 B. A collar answers with one v2 beacon starting 300 ms + (fmix32(uid ^ 0x57414B45 ^ ctr) % slots) x slot_ms after the roll call's end, sealed after the roll call is accepted; the receiver listens 300 ms + slots x slot_ms + 200 ms after sending the roll call
